An informed decision

Know the work.
Understand the commitment.

Training & support

Ask what product training, mentoring and ongoing support are provided, and who provides them.

Costs & responsibilities

Understand equipment, supplies, registration, travel and recurring costs before making a commitment.

Realistic expectations

Income depends on activity, costs and circumstances. No income or business outcome is guaranteed.

Bring these to the conversation

Your opportunity checklist.

  • What would my day-to-day role involve?
  • Which training and service standards apply?
  • What are the full upfront and ongoing costs?
  • How do sales, commissions and expenses work?
  • What are the written cancellation and return terms?
  • What support is available after I start?

This is an invitation to discuss a business pathway, not an employment offer or an earnings forecast.
